title: The past, present, and future of local-first - Martin Kleppmann (Local-First Conf)
summary: Martin Kleppmann's Local-First Conf talk reviewing where the local-first idea came from, where it stands five years after the essay, and what the community should work toward. He argues for generic sync infrastructure.
why: Cited in sync-engine and local-first threads for Kleppmann's argument for a generic, standardised sync protocol or service.

quote.text: Martin Kleppmann in his talk last year spoke [1] the need for a generic sync protocol, which was very interesting.
